coverage: title + tagline + job relevance + 8 outcomes + 8 theory code/output blocks + 9 callouts + 2 figures

top_level.improved_content: Entity resolution: baseline explicable y modelo probabilístico
top_level.justification: Current executable theory never estimates probabilistic parameters; title overstates demonstrated competency unless a real probabilistic step is added.

top_level.current_content: Motor de entity resolution testeable: benchmark etiquetado, blocking medido, comparadores explicables y cola de revisión
top_level.improved_content: Motor ER testeable con pares/labels versionados, blocking medido, comparadores con provenance, policy de decisión validada, cola auditable y métricas calculadas desde el hold-out real
top_level.justification: The current lesson calls the engine testable while canonical evidence is print-only and disconnected from the S29 truth store and T4 evaluation.

top_level.current_content: Aquí construyes un motor de entity resolution testeable: comparadores, blocking con recall medido (esto es, qué fracción de los pares verdaderos pasan el filtro rápido), pesos y umbrales, y métricas de precisión y recall. Los scores solo priorizan la cola de revisión clerical; nunca etiquetan fraude, parentesco ni colusión. En equipos de datos de bancos, telecom o retail en Perú y LatAm, este motor une contactos duplicados antes de alimentar grafos de evidencia y almacenes SQL.
top_level.improved_content: Aquí construyes y evalúas un motor de resolución de entidades con datos sintéticos: comparadores normalizados, blocking con candidate recall, un baseline ponderado y un paso probabilístico estimado, thresholds seleccionados con labels de train y una cola de revisión trazable. Los scores pueden apoyar decisiones de identidad bajo una policy validada, pero nunca son evidencia de fraude, parentesco o colusión. Cada predicción conserva el `pair_id`, las versiones de fuente/entidad, el modelo/policy y la evidencia que permiten reconstruirla antes de exportar clusters a S31.
top_level.justification: Aligns the professional claim with the actual required evidence and removes the advisory-only score contradiction.

learning_outcomes.current_content: Implementar comparadores exact, edit, token y fecha que devuelven score en [0,1] y registrar el aporte por campo
learning_outcomes.improved_content: Implementar comparadores exact/edit/token/fecha sobre una política de normalización por campo, devolver `missing` antes de comparar cuando falte evidencia y persistir aporte + versión + provenance por `pair_id`.
learning_outcomes.justification: Current comparators disagree on normalization, edit empty-empty yields 1.0 and date missing crashes.

learning_outcomes.current_content: Clasificar ausencia de campo como missing (vacío ≠ desacuerdo) y bajar el peso de valores frecuentes en acuerdos
learning_outcomes.improved_content: Definir missing tras normalización, diagnosticar disponibilidad por fuente, omitir campos missing del baseline, abstenerse si no queda evidencia y aplicar una política de frecuencia validada que realmente llegue al scorer/explain.
learning_outcomes.justification: The conceptual rule is strong but current code violates it and frequency weighting is disconnected.

learning_outcomes.current_content: Diseñar claves de blocking y medir candidate recall sobre un gold sintético etiquetado
learning_outcomes.improved_content: Diseñar reglas de blocking con normalización/missing explícitos, deduplicar pares canónicos y medir candidate recall con soporte sobre gold sintético versionado y trazable.
learning_outcomes.justification: Current empty-key and null cases are unsafe, and empty-gold recall crashes.

learning_outcomes.current_content: Estimar el costo de pares por bloque y filtrar pares imposibles antes del scorer (filter_before_score)
learning_outcomes.improved_content: Estimar `C(n,2)` por una partición de bloques, contar comparaciones únicas cuando haya varias reglas OR y aplicar reglas de exclusión validadas antes del scorer.
learning_outcomes.justification: The current cost formula is correct only for disjoint buckets and does not address dedup across multiple rules.

learning_outcomes.current_content: Calcular score ponderado didáctico y aplicar umbrales auto_match / review / non_match de forma conservadora
learning_outcomes.improved_content: Calcular un baseline ponderado solo con evidencia observada, representar `insufficient_evidence` aparte, estimar el modelo probabilístico de la sección y seleccionar/fijar thresholds válidos con labels de train antes de medir hold-out.
learning_outcomes.justification: Current baseline is not probabilistic, missing breaks it, zero evidence becomes non_match and thresholds are hardcoded/unvalidated.

learning_outcomes.current_content: Construir ítems de cola clerical y mantener consistencia de cluster con Union-Find
learning_outcomes.improved_content: Construir ítems de revisión versionados con actor/timestamp/evidencia, aceptar solo labels ER válidos y ejecutar Union-Find únicamente tras validar una decisión aprobada y cualquier restricción `cannot_link` entre componentes.
learning_outcomes.justification: Current queue omits audit fields, human approval is a comment and Union-Find cannot check negative contradictions.

learning_outcomes.current_content: Partir pares por entidad sin leakage: train/test disjuntos y pares cross_split fuera de métricas primarias
learning_outcomes.justification: Canonical T4-A implements three buckets correctly and demonstrates zero entity overlap; keep it.

learning_outcomes.current_content: Reportar precisión/recall/F1 pairwise, co-cluster completeness/quality (vista de cluster) y error slices accionables
learning_outcomes.improved_content: Calcular P/R/F1 sobre predicciones del hold-out alineadas por `pair_id`, derivar métricas de todos los pares co-cluster con soporte explícito y reportar prevalencia y slices FP/FN accionables con provenance.
learning_outcomes.justification: Current metrics are disconnected from the engine, zip can truncate, co-cluster quality can hide overmerge and no slice is actually computed.

theory_code_output.title: comparators.py
theory_code_output.improved_content: Use shared field normalization, safe reserved domains, a common missing wrapper before exact/edit/token/date and pytest assertions for NFC/NFD, empty, None and email policy cases.
theory_code_output.justification: Current edit/date violate missing and the comparator family is inconsistent.

theory_code_output.title: missing_freq.py
theory_code_output.improved_content: Normalize before missing detection, validate positive frequency support, compute source-system availability and feed effective weights into an asserted scoring test.
theory_code_output.justification: The printed heuristic is neither robust nor connected to the decision path.

theory_code_output.title: blocking_recall.py
theory_code_output.improved_content: Block via versioned shared normalization, reject/route missing keys, canonicalize/deduplicate pair ids, return recall plus support and pytest-test the intentional López/lopez regression.
theory_code_output.justification: The deliberate failure is pedagogically useful but the helper is not robust.

theory_code_output.title: cost_impossible.py
theory_code_output.improved_content: Keep C(n,2) for one partition; add cumulative unique-pair counting across OR rules and assertions proving impossible pairs are filtered before an instrumented scorer call.
theory_code_output.justification: Current output only prints the desired policy and does not prove call order or multi-rule cost.

theory_code_output.title: weights_thresh.py
theory_code_output.improved_content: Use observed-only denominator, `insufficient_evidence`, finite/range/threshold validation, a train-selected policy and a minimal estimated probabilistic path; assert boundary cases in pytest.
theory_code_output.justification: This is the largest executable contradiction in the section.

theory_code_output.title: review_cluster.py
theory_code_output.improved_content: Consume approved immutable review decisions; enforce ER label enum; retain actor/time/evidence; validate cannot-link constraints before union and persist edge decision ids for cluster provenance.
theory_code_output.justification: Current comment-driven union cannot enforce the review/contradiction contract.

theory_code_output.title: splits_entity.py
theory_code_output.justification: The split algorithm correctly produces train/test/cross and zero overlap. A pytest wrapper is desirable globally but no algorithmic rewrite is needed here.

theory_code_output.title: metrics_slices.py
theory_code_output.improved_content: Accept an aligned holdout prediction table keyed by pair_id, validate label/prediction cardinality, report confusion counts/support/prevalence, enumerate all co-cluster pairs and aggregate real error slices.
theory_code_output.justification: The current helper can return false-perfect metrics and hide transitive overmerge.

callouts.title: Criterio de cierre CP-N3-A
callouts.improved_content: Promoción = pytest del pipeline + hold-out derivado del motor + review artifacts auditables; identidad automática solo bajo policy validada, nunca fraude/parentesco.
callouts.justification: Current promotion evidence is not connected to an executable engine.

callouts.title: Explicabilidad
callouts.improved_content: Guarda por pair_id el raw/version refs, normalización, comparator/model version, aporte, score, policy version y evidence/decision ids; un vector numérico solo no es provenance.
callouts.justification: Field contributions alone cannot reconstruct the decision.

callouts.title: Missing ≠ disagree
callouts.improved_content: Missing se omite del baseline; si todos los campos están missing devuelve insufficient_evidence y review/abstain, nunca non_match.

callouts.title: Recall 0.0 = lección de normalización
callouts.justification: The deliberate red case is useful and honestly labelled; preserve it as a regression once normalization is shared.

callouts.title: Bloque de 100k
callouts.improved_content: Un bloque gigante o una clave vacía compartida puede dominar el costo; reporta candidatos únicos tras deduplicar reglas OR y aplica un guardrail explícito.
callouts.justification: Adds the missing-key and multi-rule edge that canonical code omits.

callouts.title: Auto-match conservador
callouts.improved_content: Auto-match solo con score válido, evidencia mínima suficiente y threshold seleccionado/fijado en train; cero evidencia o configuración inválida bloquea/review.
callouts.justification: High t_high alone is not a safety guarantee.

callouts.title: Consistencia transitiva
callouts.improved_content: Antes de cada union valida decisión aprobada y cannot-link constraints; conserva los decision_id de cada edge para investigar bridges/overmerge.
callouts.justification: Current Union-Find cannot perform the contradiction check named by the callout.

callouts.title: Leakage por entidad
callouts.justification: Accurate warning and canonical split demonstrates it correctly.

callouts.title: Pairwise vs. cluster
callouts.improved_content: Cluster quality must enumerate all pairs implied by predicted clusters and report support; a manual edge list can miss overmerge created by transitivity.
callouts.justification: Current implementation can report quality=1.0 for a badly overmerged cluster.

figures.improved_content: Three-way diagram: observed fields contribute to numerator+denominator; missing fields are omitted; no observed fields leads to insufficient_evidence/review rather than score 0.
figures.justification: The figure should expose the zero-evidence case the code currently mishandles.

figures.improved_content: Source/entity versions → canonical candidate pair → comparator contributions → baseline/probabilistic score + policy version → auto identity decision OR auditable review item → approved edges → validated cluster, with decision/evidence ids on every edge.
figures.justification: Current graph hides provenance and makes the grey zone look like the only human-control issue.
